intro: Abercrombie sends a sealed letter to Mayor Ello Ebonlocke in Darkshire. The hermit lives in a shack just north of Raven Hill Cemetery, claims an old friendship, and writes the missive in an archaic script.

p: After you help Abercrombie with tasks around Duskwood, the old recluse gives you a note for Mayor Ello Ebonlocke. He says the mayor is an old friend who will celebrate what you have accomplished. When Ello breaks the seal, he has no recollection of anyone named Abercrombie and cannot read a single phrase of the archaic script. He sends the note to Darkshire scholar Sirra Von'Indi for translation.
